# Gate perks and Spark

Every biome gate lets you pick a free perk card. Perks last for the rest of the run and are never sold in the upgrade shop. After you have [ascended](basics.md#ascension), a perk can also be made a [start grant](ascension-perks.md#start-grant-sockets): set it in a socket and every run starts with it, as if you had picked it at a gate.

## Perk cards

There are **39 perks**. 28 are Common and can turn up at any gate. The other 11, tagged with their rarity, stay hidden until your first ascension.

- After your first ascension, every gate has a **30%** chance to swap one of its cards for a rarer perk you have never met, as long as one fits your run. You can take it for that run.
- Seeing a perk at a gate counts as meeting it, even if you do not take it. A perk you have met is not dealt again until you pour its first fill on the [ascension perk wall](ascension-perks.md). After that fill it is in the gate pool for good.
- The 22 tagged **No downside** only ever help. Most of the rest trade one thing for another, and some pairs pull against each other, like Night Owl and Daybreak: taking the opposite card evens things out again.
- 7 perks share an effect with an [ascension node](meta-tree.md#ascension-nodes), and their cards name it. A run counts at most 2 copies of each, the node's and the perk's, and a gate stops dealing the card once you have that many, a start grant copy included.

## Spark sources

At the first gate of a run the game deals two of these 5 sources at random and you pick one. That choice lasts all run and cannot be redealt. See [Spark](basics.md#spark) for what a full meter pays.
